sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - DTC Brand Webstore

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan, China (investor jurisdiction; target WFOE registered in mainland China)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (2012)
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income (2015)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Administrative Measures for Beneficial Owner Information (PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Anti-Money Laundering Law of the PRC (2024 revision, effective 1 January 2025); Company Law of the PRC (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019); Provisions on the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration (SAMR Decree No. 43, 2021).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Division
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: not available because Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention Contracting Party. Consular Legalization route: not applicable because mainland China has no consular post in Taiwan. Sole valid route: notarize before a Taiwan district court notary; submit to the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) for certification; have SEF transmit to the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) for verification; then file the verified copy with mainland SAMR or the target bank. This cross-strait path is parallel to and never to be chained with apostille or consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Division (or authorized corporate registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: not available because Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention Contracting Party. Consular Legalization route: not applicable. Sole valid route: obtain an official recent Good Standing certificate from the Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs; notarize the certificate before a Taiwan district court notary; process through SEF and ARATS verification; then submit with a mainland Chinese translation to SAMR, tax authorities, and banks. No sequential use of apostille or consular legalization is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE formation and bank onboarding
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors or shareholders' meeting of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: not available for Taiwan-issued instruments. Consular Legalization route: not applicable. Sole valid route: execute the resolution or power of attorney in notarized form in Taiwan; the Taiwan notary certifies signatures; the notarial certificate is then verified by SEF and ARATS; the verified instrument is translated and notarized in mainland China before presentation to the formation agent and the target bank. Do not chain with apostille or consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan investing company, as filed with the Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: not available because Taiwan is not a Hague Apostille member. Consular Legalization route: not applicable. Sole valid route: obtain a certified copy from the Taiwan corporate registry; notarize the copy in Taiwan; pass through SEF certification and ARATS verification; produce a mainland Chinese notarial translation; then use it for UBO analysis, registered capital declaration, and banking KYC. The cross-strait verification path is exclusive and must not be combined with apostille or consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: not available because Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention Contracting Party. Consular Legalization route: not applicable. Sole valid route: obtain the bank reference letter on bank letterhead signed by an authorized officer; notarize the signature before a Taiwan notary; verify through SEF and ARATS; translate and notarize in mainland China; present the final verified bilingual set to the WFOE bank account opening officer. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel alternatives for other jurisdictions but inapplicable here and must never be appended to this path.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP and sanctions screening must be completed before signing and refreshed again within five business days before filing. Identify politically exposed persons (current or former senior officials, judges, military leaders, state-owned enterprise executives, political party officers), their immediate family members and close associates. Screen against UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, OFAC SDN, UK/EU sanctions, PRC Ministry of Public Security wanted/terror lists, and Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission blacklists. Apply enhanced due diligence to PEPs, verify source of wealth and funds, detect shell-company red flags, and retain decision records for at least five years under PRC AML law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Self-Declaration and Clearance System via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory Chinese company name must be in simplified Chinese characters and follow the four-tier structure: administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry or business characteristics, and legal form. The foreign investor name must be rendered in a phonetic pinyin transliteration. An English name may be registered as a secondary name only and cannot replace the Chinese statutory name. Traditional Chinese characters from Taiwan investor documents must be converted to simplified Chinese in the registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR name system rejects a proposed name, the applicant may within 15 working days from written rejection file an administrative reconsideration with the next-higher Authority, or immediately submit an alternative name through the same online portal. If reconsideration is denied or not decided within the statutory period, an administrative lawsuit may be filed within six months. The appeal must attach the rejection notice, the proposed Chinese name and its pinyin transliteration, a justification showing no prohibited token use, and proof of trademark or goodwill support. Running a parallel new name application is prudent to preserve priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices and commercial mailboxes are generally not accepted as the sole registered address for a WFOE. Municipal SAMR, tax bureaus, and banks require a physical address that supports lease agreements, utility bills, VAT invoice issuance, payroll, and potential on-site verification. In selected free trade zones, a qualified incubator or co-working registered address hosting may be accepted, but the company must still maintain demonstrable operational substance and a service agreement; pure virtual mailboxes create high risk of bank account freezing, VAT denial, and administrative penalties.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) office sign, (2) lease contract and rent receipts, (3) utility bills, (4) statutory books and seals, (5) VAT invoice system output, (6) payroll and social insurance records, (7) inventory or third-party logistics agreements, (8) Shopify sales records accessible. Quantified risk: for a newly formed low-risk DTC WFOE, 15-20% probability of an unannounced SAMR address verification in year one and 10-15% probability of a municipal tax bureau site visit within the first two years; risk rises with VAT refunds, export transactions, or inconsistent address reporting.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company registration and business license issuance with SAMR
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory official fee; the PRC does not charge a government filing fee for company incorporation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and unified social credit code application
Company seal engraving (legal representative, financial, contract, and invoice seals)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in Shanghai; depends on number of seals and e-seal service.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered address service in a pilot free trade zone incubator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Free trade zone incubator or registered address provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for one-year address hosting and lease support.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and cross-strait SEF/ARATS verification of Taiwan investor documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Taiwan district court notary and SEF/ARATS authentication service windows
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff plus SEF/ARATS processing fees; actual quote depends on document count.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chinese translation and notarization of translated corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Chinese translation company and PRC notary office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a corporate registration document set.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel fee for WFOE incorporation, name clearance, and UBO filings
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard e-commerce WFOE with cross-strait investor.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account opening assistance and AML compliance support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial bank onboarding consultant or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for documentation preparation, beneficial owner declaration, and PEP screening.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan (公司法), Articles 128-156 (incorporation and structure of company limited by shares) and Article 410 (registration requirement); Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, Article 73 (mandatory permission for mainland Chinese investors); Regulations Governing Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Chinese Investors, Articles 4-12; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, applied mutatis mutandis to non-mainland foreign investors.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Commercial Development Administration (MOEA-CDA, 經濟部商業發展署) — Company Registration Division; MOEA Investment Commission (經濟部投資審議委員會) for prior investment permission.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application Form (公司設立登記申請書) submitted through the MOEA Online Company Registration System, together with the Investment Approval Application Form (投資申請書) and the Mainland Investment Permission Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital under the Company Act of Taiwan. The issued capital stated in the Articles of Incorporation must be fully paid in by the shareholders before filing; funds must be deposited in a bank account opened in the exact corporate name (escrow-equivalent deposit), evidenced by a bank capital deposit certificate accompanying the registration application. Funds become freely available only after registration approval. The MOEA Investment Commission may impose supplementary capital adequacy conditions in the approval letter for mainland Chinese investors.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the Organizational Meeting of CN WFOE LTD held on [date]: (1) the Articles of Incorporation submitted by the promoters are approved and adopted; (2) the directors certify that the issued shares have been fully subscribed and the total paid-in capital has been deposited into the Company's bank account in accordance with the Company Act; (3) the registered office located at [Taipei business address] is adopted as the statutory registered office; (4) [Director A] is appointed Chairman, [Director B] is appointed General Manager, and [Director C] is appointed Company Secretary; and (5) the Chairman and General Manager, jointly and severally, are authorized to execute and file all incorporation, investment-permission, tax, and business-registration documents, to control the capital deposit account, and to affix the corporate seal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Mainland-China Investment Permission and WFOE Eligibility Pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Investment Commission (經濟部投資審議委員會), Taipei
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the online investment permission application through the Investment Commission portal. Provide identity and governance documents of the Chinese parent, audited financial statements, a business plan describing the Taiwan DTC webstore, and a certified shareholder resolution. The Commission checks the target activity (ISIC 4791 internet retail) against the positive and negative lists for mainland investment in Taiwan. Upon approval, obtain the Investment Approval Letter before commencing incorporation.
required_dossiers: Parent company business license and articles of association (notarized)
Parent audited financial statements for the last two years
Parent board/shareholder resolution authorizing the Taiwan investment and capital amount
Investment application form with proposed Taiwan entity details and business plan
Identity/passport copies of Taiwan promoters, directors, and shareholders
Notarized power of attorney to the Taiwan filing agent
Compliance undertaking letter covering Taiwan sensitive-sector restrictions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan within 30 days, or amend and resubmit the investment plan addressing the Commission's stated reasons. A supplementary CPA opinion and revised capital plan typically cures capital-sufficiency queries within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Check Company Name and Deposit Paid-In Capital in Escrow-Style Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA-CDA Company Name Pre-approval System; Taiwan commercial bank maintaining the corporate capital collection account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for company name and business scope pre-approval through the MOEA online name registration portal. Upon name approval, open a temporary corporate bank account in the exact proposed company name. Execute capital remittance from the Chinese parent through the approved cross-strait banking channel and obtain a bank capital deposit certificate. The funds remain segregated until the company registration is completed.
required_dossiers: Company name pre-approval application (online)
Draft Articles of Incorporation
Mainland investment approval letter (from Step 1)
Identity documents of promoter directors and shareholders
Cross-strait capital remittance confirmation from the parent's bank
Bank account opening application and financial crime compliance forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited wording, submit an alternative name application and reopen or rename the bank account upon the updated name approval. Cross-strait remittance delays are cured by presenting the Investment Approval Letter to both correspondents and using the NTD/RMB clearing mechanism designated by the Central Bank of Taiwan.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Company Incorporation Registration and Obtain Establishment Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA-CDA — Company Registration Online System (公司登記一站式申請)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation registration package online: registration application, endorsed Articles of Incorporation, shareholder and director lists, capital deposit certificate, registered office lease and site consent, and the Investment Commission Approval Letter. The MOEA-CDA issues the Company Registration Certificate and the Uniform Identification Code (統一編號). The company is legally incorporated as of the registration date.
required_dossiers: Company incorporation registration application form
Notarized/endorsed Articles of Incorporation
Bank capital deposit certificate
MOEA Investment Commission Approval Letter
Registered office lease or title deed and landlord site consent
List of directors, shareholders, and officers with identity documents
Payment receipt for government registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is formally defective, the MOEA issues a cure notice; the applicant may rectify without re-filing fees within 15 days. If the Investment Approval Letter has expired, request an extension from the Investment Commission before resubmitting. Site defects are cured by adding a supplementary landlord consent or filing a Company Domicile Declaration (公司地址聲明書).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Uniform Invoice Enrollment, and Labor/Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau (財政部各地區國稅局); Central Health Insurance Administration; Bureau of Labor Insurance; municipal finance and commerce offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the local National Taxation Bureau for profit-seeking enterprise income tax and business tax purposes. Obtain the tax registration seal and enroll in the Uniform Invoice system. Register the company as an employer for labor insurance, national health insurance, and labor pension contributions. For the Shopify DTC brand, register all Taiwan-source webstore revenue, prepare VAT filings on the Shopify/Stripe/PayPal payment reconciliation, and maintain transfer-pricing documentation for the parent-group cross-border services.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate
Articles of Incorporation and officer identity documents
Lease or site consent for tax domicile
Accounting system policy declaration and tentative profit method election
Shopify store agreement and Stripe/PayPal/Shopify Payments processing confirmations
Employer enrollment forms for labor and health insurance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau queries economic substance or transfer pricing, file a Taiwan transfer-pricing compliance declaration and submit the cross-border service agreement within the 30-day cure period. Voluntary correction before audit mitigates penalties; any registration data mismatch is cured by filing Form 105 and a written justification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Physical Site Compliance: Fire Safety, Building Clearance, and Environmental Exemption Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Fire Department (消防局); Municipal Public Works/Building Office; District Environmental Protection Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the office and fulfillment warehouse used for DTC operations, implement fire safety measures required by the Fire Services Act including egress marking, smoke detectors, extinguishers, and an evacuation plan. Submit a building occupancy and structural load certificate to the municipal building office confirming the site's permitted use. File an environmental exemption self-assessment and, if the site is a warehousing center, submit the waste disposal contract to the Environmental Protection Bureau.
required_dossiers: Fire safety self-inspection and completion declaration
Building use permit (使用執照) and lease contract
Floor plan with racking and load calculations
Waste disposal contract with a licensed carrier
Environmental exemption self-assessment form
Occupational safety and health workplace checklist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the building office determines the use violates the occupancy permit, apply for a change-of-use amendment or relocate to a compliant industrial/commercial unit. Fire safety defects are cured by a two-week corrective plan and re-inspection by a licensed fire-equipment installer. Unexpected EIA triggers due to floor area are cured by filing a Category D fast-track review with the Ministry of Environment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — ISIC 4791 DTC internet retail is an unrestricted commercial activity in Taiwan. General commercial registration authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Commercial Development Administration and the municipal commerce office (e.g., Taipei City Government Department of Commerce).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required. The company operates under the Company Registration Certificate and Municipal Business Registration; there is no sector-specific operating permit for pure internet retail under Taiwan's regulatory matrix.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan (環境部), Environmental Protection Administration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category D service/retail activity below Taiwan's EIA statutory thresholds for non-industrial operations. A voluntary self-assessment exemption filing is required where the company operates a distribution warehouse exceeding applicable floor-area triggers.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for pure office/DTC retail. For warehouse operations: wastewater discharge to the municipal sewer must comply with the Water Pollution Control Act (daily flow below 100 m3; effluent COD ≤ 100 mg/L, SS ≤ 60 mg/L); generator and forklift emissions must meet the Air Pollution Control Act stationary/mobile source limits; general and commercial waste must be handled under licensed contracts pursuant to the Waste Disposal Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification per the Fire Services Act, including annual self-inspection and compliance statement for small workplaces; building occupancy and structural load inspection under Article 77 of the Building Act; occupational safety and health clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act for the warehouse and office workforce. No civil-defense shelter conversion is required for non-critical internet commerce premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局, www.chinatax.gov.cn); digital portal: Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局, etax.chinatax.gov.cn); customs/e-commerce clearance: China International Trade Single Window (中国国际贸易单一窗口, singlewindow.cn). Taiwan-side nexus: Ministry of Finance (財政部賦稅署) and National Tax Administration (online remote-seller registration at tax.nat.gov.tw).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the WFOE as a limited liability company with the competent Market Supervision Administration to obtain the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Identifier (统一社会信用代码), which serves as the taxpayer identification number (TIN). Step 2: Complete consolidated tax registration with the Electronic Tax Bureau within 30 days of the business license date, activating corporate income tax (CIT), VAT, and withholding tax filing obligations. Step 3: Elect VAT status — General VAT Taxpayer (增值税一般纳税人) or Small-Scale Taxpayer (小规模纳税人); the general taxpayer status is mandatory once annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000 and is required for export zero-rating input credits. Step 4: File export tax refund registration (出口退(免)税备案) with the tax authority and register the cross-border e-commerce retail export (跨境电商零售出口, 9610/9710) customs status with the competent customs office. Step 5: Register in the SAFE trade-in-foreign-exchange list (货物贸易外汇收支名录) through the settlement bank to obtain legal export FX receipt and repatriation eligibility.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: PRC law does not provide a check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch entity classification; a WFOE is per se a Chinese resident enterprise taxed under the Enterprise Income Tax Law at a headline rate of 25% on worldwide income. Available elections: (i) voluntary registration as a General VAT Taxpayer when annual VAT-taxable sales do not exceed RMB 5,000,000, or retention of Small-Scale Taxpayer status (levy rates 1–3%); (ii) foreign tax credit election for overseas taxes (direct and indirect credit) under the EIT Law; (iii) small low-profit enterprise concession producing an effective 5% EIT rate for taxable income not exceeding RMB 3,000,000 with no more than 300 employees and RMB 50,000,000 in assets; (iv) installment and quarterly prepayment election for CIT; (v) no binding cross-strait double taxation agreement is currently in force with Taiwan (the 2015 Cross-Strait Agreement remains unratified in Taiwan), hence no treaty-based check-the-box or tie-breaker election is available, and the General Anti-Avoidance Rules (特别纳税调整) govern hybrid arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (China Value-Added Tax, 增值税) with export zero-rating, supplemented by destination-jurisdiction Taiwan Business Tax (營業稅) remote-seller VAT nexus for cross-border DTC e-commerce
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: PRC: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable VAT sales — compulsory General VAT Taxpayer registration; below the threshold the WFOE may remain a Small-Scale Taxpayer. Taiwan nexus: a mainland remote seller of goods or digital services to Taiwan consumers must register for Taiwan Business Tax when annual taxable sales of digital services exceed TWD 480,000; low-value goods imports with a customs value not exceeding TWD 2,000 per shipment are exempt from import duty and business tax at Taiwan customs clearance.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Golden Tax Phase IV fully digitalized e-invoice (数电票/全面数字化电子发票) mandate: all VAT invoices issued by the WFOE are generated in real time through the Electronic Tax Bureau with mandatory 24/7 API-based fiscal data transmission, tax-authority electronic digital stamping, and no paper invoice or physical stamping for registered general taxpayers. Export and e-commerce parcel clearance is conducted electronically through the China International Trade Single Window with no paper customs documentation. If the WFOE triggers Taiwan remote-seller registration, it must issue Taiwan electronic invoices (電子發票) through an approved platform and file bimonthly Business Tax returns with the Taiwan National Tax Administration.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The WFOE may apply the 0% export VAT rate with input-VAT credit/refund (出口退(免)税) where: (1) it holds General VAT Taxpayer status; (2) goods are physically exported from mainland China under customs supervision, including shipments to Taiwan as a separate customs territory via cross-strait logistics or the 9610 retail-export / 9710 B2B e-commerce / 9810 overseas-warehouse regimes; (3) each shipment is covered by an electronic customs export declaration evidencing that the goods left China; (4) export proceeds are collected from the overseas buyer in foreign currency and repatriated within the statutory FX deadline; (5) the goods are not on the prohibited or restricted export duty-rebate negative lists; and (6) Shopify order records, payment-rail settlement data (Shopify Payments, Stripe, PayPal), and logistics manifests reconcile to the declared customs value. Offshore services rendered to overseas customers may qualify for zero-rating or exemption when supplied from mainland China to recipients abroad with no domestic consumption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口货物报关单, electronic via the China International Trade Single Window)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / cross-strait transit manifest (海运提单、空运单或两岸物流托运单)
Inward Foreign Exchange Remittance Certificate and SAFE reporting confirmation (出口收汇银行入账凭证/涉外收入申报单)
Commercial Invoice and export special invoice (出口发票)
Sales contract or e-commerce purchase order (出口销售合同/跨境电商订单)
E-commerce platform settlement evidence (Shopify order log, Shopify Payments/Stripe/PayPal settlement statements)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export VAT refunds are subject to prior risk-screening and joint special-task-force scrutiny by tax, customs, foreign-exchange and public-security authorities (四部门联合打击骗税机制). The tax authority may retrospectively claw back the full refunded VAT, impose a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05%, levy fines ranging from 1x to 5x of the fraudulently obtained refund (Tax Collection and Administration Law Art. 66), downgrade the exporter's customs credit rating, suspend or cancel export-tax-refund eligibility and foreign-exchange collection rights, and may refer the case for criminal prosecution. Fraudulently obtaining export tax refunds constitutes the crime of 骗取出口退税罪 (Criminal Law Art. 204) punishable by imprisonment up to life for especially huge amounts; administrative termination of cross-border e-commerce export filing status and payment-rail settlement may also follow. On the Taiwan side, evasion of remote-seller registration triggers back-assessment of the 5% Business Tax, a 5% late payment surcharge, and fines up to three times the evaded amount under the Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act (加值型及非加值型營業稅法).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC / 中国人民银行) as the central bank, with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE / 国家外汇管理局) as the exclusive foreign exchange administration for the mainland-operating WFOE. The Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan, CBC / 中央銀行) separately governs NT dollar flows for the Taiwan parent shareholder, but does not control the WFOE's onshore RMB or FX treasury.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible for current account items (goods, services, dividends of a real nature) under IMF Article VIII, as implemented through SAFE's verified-transaction regime: every current account receipt or payment must have genuine, documented underlying trade or service activities (真实性、合规性审核). Capital account items remain restricted: inbound foreign direct investment is permitted after market regulation filing (外商投资信息报告) and SAFE FDI registration; profit remittance is classified as a current account

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Settlement Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau (Ministry of Finance) with territorial jurisdiction over the WFOE's registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from May 1 through May 31 in the year following the close of the taxable year (calendar-year WFOE); non-calendar fiscal year companies file within 5 months of fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under Income Tax Act Art. 108: 3% late-filing surcharge on the assessed tax after a delinquency notice (statutory minimum amounts apply for nil or low tax); failure to file after investigation triggers an additional 6% surcharge; late payment adds 1% per 2 days up to 15%; understated or false returns subject to penalties up to twice the understated tax, enforced through administrative collection and asset seizure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Provisional Income Tax Prepayment (營利事業所得稅暫繳申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau (Ministry of Finance), regional bureau at the registered office jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from September 1 through September 30 of the current taxable year; exemption applies where prior-year return showed no tax payable or the computed provisional tax does not exceed NT$2,000.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid or short-paid provisional tax accrues interest at the Postal Savings one-year time-deposit rate and is collected with the annual settlement under Income Tax Act Art. 68; late-payment surcharge may additionally apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements, Business Report, and Profit Appropriation Approval (年度決算書表之承認 through 股東常會 or sole-shareholder written resolution)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate records retained at the registered office; sole-shareholder written resolution in lieu of an annual general meeting (no external filing and no government fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end (by June 30 for a calendar-year WFOE); the board must prepare final accounts and submit them for shareholder approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors may be fined NT$10,000-NT$50,000 by the competent authority for failure to prepare or submit final accounts; persistent non-operation may trigger a MOEA dissolution order where the company has ceased business for 6 or more months (Company Law Art. 10).

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% (Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax; a further 5% surtax applies to undistributed retained earnings under the Income Basic Tax Act)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for DTC/e-commerce retail. Applicable tax offsets: (i) R&D investment credit equal to 10-15% of qualified R&D expenditures under the Statute for Industrial Innovation, capped at 30% of income tax; (ii) 5-year profit exemption only for MOEA-approved strategic industries, which ordinary Shopify brand retailers will not normally obtain; (iii) for SMEs only, a temporary reduction in the retained-earnings surtax where earnings are reinvested in qualifying assets. The practical effective rate for a trading WFOE is 20% CIT plus 5% surtax on accumulated undistributed profit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 9006 Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Settlement Return, e-filed through the Ministry of Finance e-Filing portal (tax.nat.gov.tw, 'IRX' e-filing system). The Basic Income (AMT) Schedule and Attachment 27 (Related-Party Transaction Disclosure) are incorporated in the same electronic return. A CPA tax attestation is mandatory where annual revenue exceeds TWD 100 million or where transfer-pricing thresholds are met.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement, supplemented by a mandatory provisional prepayment instalment filed 1-30 September of the current year and monthly withholding returns where dividends, interest, rents or royalties are paid to non-residents.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final return must be filed between 1 May and 31 May of the year following the fiscal year-end for calendar-year enterprises; the September provisional prepayment covers estimated first-half-year tax; any balance of tax is payable at the May filing date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Shopify webstore sales proceeds from all payment rails (Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe) before deduction of gateway commissions, refunds or chargebacks.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Taiwan WFOE must recognize Taiwan-source internet retail income on a gross basis; do not net payment-processing fees against revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 02 - Sales returns, allowances and discounts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Refunds, voucher discounts and chargebacks properly substantiated by payment-gateway settlement reports.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions are allowed only where the amount is evidenced by the settlement statements of the non-resident payment provider.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fulfillment, warehousing, logistics, advertising (Meta, Google, Shopify), payment-gateway fees, salaries and third-party services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany service fees payable to the PRC parent or affiliated Hong Kong/US service providers must pass the arm's-length benefit test and be supported by documented cost breakdowns; unsupported fees are recharacterized as constructive dividends subject to 21% WHT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 23 - Net operating profit before tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit after cost of goods sold and operating expenses; must reconcile to the CPA-audited financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A net margin below the e-commerce industry norm (generally 4-8%) will trigger a tax audit and TP scrutiny on purchases from affiliated suppliers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of prior-year tax losses against current-year taxable income; Taiwan permits a 10-year carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses declared by the Taiwan WFOE are eligible; losses of the PRC parent cannot be transferred to the Taiwan entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 55 - Income tax at statutory rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 20% CIT computed on taxable income before credits and prepayments; AMT top-up and the 5% retained-earnings surtax are computed in the attached Basic Income Schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify withholding tax credits on interest and royalty income; undistributed profit subject to the 5% surtax is considered when planning dividend remittances to the PRC parent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of all transactions with the PRC parent and affiliates: inventory purchases, IP royalties, management fees, shareholder loans and brand service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must disclose the parent's full legal name, registration number, country of tax residence and amounts per transaction category; non-disclosure reverses the burden of proof in any TP adjustment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: the tax authority issues a demand notice; continued default triggers a penalty of 3% of the assessed tax for every two months, capped at 10% (Art. 108 Income Tax Act). Late payment: delinquency surcharge of 1% per two-day period, capped at 15% of the unpaid amount (Art. 20 Tax Collection Act). Understatement: civil penalty of 2-3 times the underpaid tax (Art. 110); willful evasion is criminal (Art. 41 Tax Collection Act). Failure to furnish TP documentation attracts separate fixed fines and re-assessment of taxable income.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% on gross dividends paid to a non-resident corporate shareholder, including a Mainland Chinese parent (Art. 88 and Art. 89 Income Tax Act). The Taiwan WFOE must withhold and remit the tax within 10 days from the distribution date. Undistributed earnings remain exposed to the 5% retained-earnings surtax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No double taxation agreement (DTA) is in force between the PRC and Taiwan. The Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation, signed 25 August 2015, is unratified and provides no current relief; therefore a PRC parent cannot claim a reduced dividend rate via a Tax Residency Certificate. Generic treaty protocol for jurisdictions with an effective DTA: submit the approved Withholding Tax Rate Reduction application to the district National Taxation Bureau before remittance, attach a valid Tax Residency Certificate issued by the counterparty competent authority, a beneficial-ownership declaration, and the board resolution authorizing the distribution; the application is processed prospectively and any over-withheld amount is refunded at the annual settlement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to a non-resident enterprise: 20% statutory WHT, reduced to 10% or 15% only under an applicable DTA. Interest paid to a non-resident enterprise: 20% statutory WHT, often reduced to 10% under DTAs. For a PRC parent, no treaty reduction applies, so 20% WHT is imposed on both royalties and interest. Additionally, shareholder-loan interest exceeding the 3:1 debt-to-equity thin-capitalization safe harbor is non-deductible (Art. 43-2 Income Tax Act) and is recharacterized as a deemed dividend.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: TWD: mandatory Transfer Pricing Report (Local File) when annual related-party revenue-type transactions exceed TWD 50 million or expense-type transactions exceed TWD 20 million; Master File and Country-by-Country notification are required where the MNE group has consolidated revenue above TWD 27 billion. In all cases, cross-border related-party transactions must be disclosed on Attachment 27 of the annual return.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not apply the offshore-center Economic Substance Regulations model. However, for Mainland-invested WFOEs, the Mainland Investment Regulations require genuine local substance: a real office lease, at least one full-time Taiwan payroll employee, local books and board records, and actual management of the webstore in Taiwan. A WFOE used as an invoicing shell without local operating substance is recharacterized under Art. 43-1 Income Tax Act (general anti-avoidance), with income reattributed to the PRC parent, and the Investment Commission may revoke the investment permit and order divestment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing Shopify DTC proceeds to a Hong Kong or US PayPal/Stripe account held personally by the director or a nominee, while failing to record the sales in the Taiwan WFOE's books; under-declaring the e-commerce tax base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-assessment of 20% CIT, 5% retained-earnings surtax and VAT under-reporting penalties; civil penalty of up to 3 times the evaded tax under Art. 110 Income Tax Act; criminal liability under Art. 41 Tax Collection Act with imprisonment of up to 5 years and fines up to TWD 10 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The responsible director is the named offender for criminal tax evasion; conviction results in imprisonment; once tax is confirmed and unpaid above TWD 100,000, a court-ordered travel ban applies (Art. 24 Tax Collection Act); the corporate veil may be pierced if the director diverted corporate assets overseas.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company - Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Mainland-invested WFOE maintaining no independent premises, no Taiwan payroll, no local inventory and no local decision-making, while acting solely as an invoicing and payment intermediary for a Shopify brand managed from mainland China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the Mainland investment permit and mandatory divestment by the MOEA Investment Commission; tax authority disregard of the WFOE under Art. 43-1 Income Tax Act, reattributing the e-commerce income to the PRC parent; deemed 21% withholding on any actual repatriation; refusal of VAT input credit on purchasing invoices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false substance declarations face criminal liability for filing false documents; the PRC parent shareholder cannot invoke the corporate veil defense under Art. 154 Company Act where the corporate form is abused; directors may be jointly liable for restitution of unwarranted tax benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Purchasing inventory from the PRC parent at a fixed 5% gross margin without benchmarking, paying royalties for IP the parent does not legally own or actively use in Taiwan, or failing to file Attachment 27 and the TP report despite exceeding TWD 20 million/50 million transaction thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Discretionary TP adjustment of taxable income to the arm's-length result; civil penalty of up to 3 times the underpaid tax (Art. 110); separate fixed fines of TWD 3,000-30,000 for failure to produce required TP documentation, with the burden of proof reversed for transactions with related parties in tax-haven jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Knowingly false TP attestations are treated as fraudulent tax declarations, exposing directors to criminal sanctions under the Tax Collection Act; directors may also owe indemnification to the company if the TP adjustment creates capital deficiency or triggers insolvent trading claims.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Cross-Border Settlement Abuse and False Invoicing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving e-commerce receipts through personal bank accounts or third-party nominee collection accounts; issuing or procuring fake transport and logistics e-invoices to inflate costs of goods sold from the PRC supplier; operating multiple Shopify payout accounts to prevent transaction aggregation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money Laundering Control Act: corporate fines up to TWD 5 million and imprisonment of up to 7 years for responsible persons engaged in intentional money laundering; Uniform Invoice Punishment Regulations: fines up to TWD 1 million, suspension of business, and publication of the company name; VAT evasion penalty of up to 5 times the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director personally receiving diverted payments is the primary money-laundering actor and faces imprisonment; directors authorizing false e-invoicing are jointly and severally liable for the evaded VAT and CIT, and such tax claims survive bankruptcy discharge.
